name: RACI Matrix
description: Responsibility Assignment Matrix: roles per activity and stakeholder
whenToUse: When each activity of an undertaking needs a record of who does the work (R), who is accountable (A), who is consulted (C) and who is informed (I) — the check reports every row without an R, without an A or with more than one A; not for describing the flow itself, which is what a flowchart is for.
addStakeholderHint: Now add stakeholders to assign roles.
renameFailed: The name could not be applied.

invariants.activityIds: Every activity has its own non-empty id without a colon.
invariants.stakeholderIds: Every stakeholder has its own non-empty id without a colon.
invariants.knownCells: A role belongs to an existing activity and an existing stakeholder.
